prescribedGeometry.description: Exact A3.1 prescribed display paths with one common frequency and independently selected remaining A3 coordinates.

choices: The flattening coordinate lambda_A=0 selects the mutually orthogonal near-rest endpoint, with binary orbit planes yz, xz, and xy in the declared relative frame.
Every binary midpoint is the braid origin in the relative frame; each positive h_a separates the two endpoint orbit centers along the binary axis.
The common frequency f=0.25 and all remaining binary coordinates are prescribed display choices within A3.1.
Normalized linear axis interpolation defines the wider taxonomy path but does not alter this near-rest representative.
